title: Calm Foundations
author: Noah Brandt
description: Five first steps for anyone new to meditation: arriving, breathing, feeling the body, watching thoughts, and taking the calm into an ordinary day.

sessions.title: Arriving
sessions.subtitle: Just sit down
sessions.description: Nothing to get right. Sit, notice you are here, and feel the weight of the body on the chair or floor.

sessions.title: The Breath
sessions.subtitle: Your built-in anchor
sessions.description: Find the breath where it is easiest to feel, at the nose, the chest or the belly, and let attention rest there.

sessions.title: The Body
sessions.subtitle: Feeling from the inside
sessions.description: A short scan from feet to head, noticing sensation without needing to change it.

sessions.title: Thoughts
sessions.subtitle: Letting them pass
sessions.description: Thoughts will come. Practise noticing one, labelling it gently, and coming back to the breath.

sessions.title: Everyday Calm
sessions.subtitle: Taking it with you
sessions.description: Small ways to return to this feeling during the day: a breath at a doorway, a pause before a message.

title: Focus Reset
author: Ava Lindqvist
description: Five sessions for a scattered mind. Train attention in short, kind repetitions, then carry it into the work that matters.

sessions.title: Single Point
sessions.subtitle: One thing at a time
sessions.description: Rest attention on one small point and notice how often it wants to move.

sessions.title: The Wandering Mind
sessions.subtitle: Every return counts
sessions.description: Wandering is not failing. Each time you notice and come back is the practice itself.

sessions.title: Before Deep Work
sessions.subtitle: Clear the desk inside
sessions.description: Set down what is unfinished, choose the one task ahead, and begin from a settled place.

sessions.title: The Long Hold
sessions.subtitle: Staying a little longer
sessions.description: A longer sit that stretches attention gently, a few breaths further each time.

sessions.title: Closing the Day
sessions.subtitle: Switch off on purpose
sessions.description: Mark the end of work so the mind stops reaching for it. Let attention widen and soften.

title: Kind to Yourself
author: Ines Moreau
description: Five gentle practices in self-compassion: meeting difficulty with warmth instead of criticism, one small step at a time.

sessions.title: Hand on Heart
sessions.subtitle: A simple gesture of care
sessions.description: Place a hand on your chest, feel its warmth, and notice what it is like to be met kindly.

sessions.title: The Inner Voice
sessions.subtitle: Softening the critic
sessions.description: Listen to how you speak to yourself, and try a gentler tone, as you would with a friend.

sessions.title: Common Ground
sessions.subtitle: You are not the only one
sessions.description: Whatever you are finding hard, others are finding hard too. Let that be a comfort rather than a weight.

sessions.title: What Do You Need?
sessions.subtitle: Asking, and listening
sessions.description: Ask yourself what would help right now, and stay quiet long enough to hear an answer.

sessions.title: Warm Wishes
sessions.subtitle: May I be well
sessions.description: A few simple phrases of goodwill, offered to yourself first and then outward to others.

title: Better Mornings
author: Ava Lindqvist
description: Five short starts to the day. Wake the body, set one intention, and step out the door steadier than you woke up.

sessions.title: Waking Slowly
sessions.subtitle: Before you reach for the phone
sessions.description: Stay in bed a few minutes longer. Feel the body waking, and let the day arrive at its own pace.

sessions.title: One Intention
sessions.subtitle: Choose how to meet the day
sessions.description: Pick one quality to carry with you today, patience, curiosity or kindness, and rest in it for a while.

sessions.title: Energising Breath
sessions.subtitle: A brighter start
sessions.description: Steady, even counts to clear the fog and bring a little alertness without coffee.

sessions.title: Morning Gratitude
sessions.subtitle: Something to look forward to
sessions.description: Name a few things you are glad of, and one thing in the day ahead you are looking forward to.

sessions.title: Stepping Out
sessions.subtitle: Carry it through the door
sessions.description: A last minute of stillness, then a cue to come back to whenever the day gets busy.

title: Letting Go of Stress
author: Noah Brandt
description: Five practices for a body and mind under pressure: find where stress lives, release it, and build a little more room for the next hard day.

sessions.title: Stress Map
sessions.subtitle: Where does it sit?
sessions.description: Scan the body for tightness and heat. Just notice where stress has made a home today.

sessions.title: Release on the Out-Breath
sessions.subtitle: Let the exhale do the work
sessions.description: Breathe into each tight place, and let it loosen a little more on every long breath out.

sessions.title: Worry Time
sessions.subtitle: A place to put it
sessions.description: Give your worries a set time and place, so they do not need to follow you around all day.

sessions.title: More Room
sessions.subtitle: Widening around the difficulty
sessions.description: Rather than pushing a feeling away, let awareness grow wider than it, until it has room to move.

sessions.title: The Two-Minute Reset
sessions.subtitle: For the middle of a hard day
sessions.description: A short, practical reset you can use anywhere: feet, breath, shoulders, and back to it.

title: Breath School
author: Ines Moreau
description: Five lessons in breathing, from simply noticing the breath to the classic patterns for calm, focus and sleep.

sessions.title: The Natural Breath
sessions.subtitle: Watching, not changing
sessions.description: Before changing anything, get to know your breath as it is: its pace, its depth, its pauses.

sessions.title: Belly Breathing
sessions.subtitle: Low and slow
sessions.description: Let the breath drop down into the belly, so the shoulders can stay still and soft.

sessions.title: Box Breathing
sessions.subtitle: Four even sides
sessions.description: In, hold, out, hold, four counts each. A steadying pattern for focus under pressure.

sessions.title: Coherent Breathing
sessions.subtitle: Finding your rhythm
sessions.description: An even five in and five out, kept up long enough for the body to settle into it.

sessions.title: Breathing for Sleep
sessions.subtitle: Four, seven, eight
sessions.description: The long, slow out-breath that helps the body wind down. Best done lying down, lights low.
